mapper.select: SELECT DRONE_ID AS droneId, URL AS url, DRONE_STATUS AS droneStatus, ACTIVE_STATUS AS activeStatus, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName FROM DRONES WHERE DRONE_ID = #{droneId}
SELECT DRONE_ID AS droneId, URL AS url, DRONE_STATUS AS droneStatus, ACTIVE_STATUS AS activeStatus, ZONE_NAME AS zoneName FROM DRONES ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(DRONE_ID, 7)) ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DRONES ( DRONE_ID, URL, DRONE_STATUS, ACTIVE_STATUS, ZONE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{droneId}, #{url}, #{droneStatus}, #{activeStatus}, #{zoneName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DRONES SET URL = #{url}, DRONE_STATUS = #{droneStatus}, ACTIVE_STATUS = #{activeStatus}, ZONE_NAME = #{zoneName} WHERE DRONE_ID = #{droneId}
